metadata.description: A comprehensive community-driven collection of 117 AI agents, 174 slash commands, 28 hooks, and 199 MCP servers for Claude Code

plugins.name: mobile-debug-tools
plugins.description: Inspect and interact with Android and iOS apps through the mobile-debug-mcp server and a usage skill.

plugins.name: pine
plugins.description: Connect Claude to Pine AI to handle real-world tasks and follow up on progress and results.

plugins.name: claude-imagine
plugins.description: Generate and edit AI images and videos from inside Claude Code through one remote MCP server. Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2.5, Seedream 4.5, Flux 2 Pro and Z-Image for stills; Veo, Kling, Seedance, Grok Imagine and MiniMax for clips. quote_generation prices any call before you spend, and failed generations are refunded automatically. OAuth via /mcp; no API key to paste.

plugins.name: crosstalk
plugins.description: Let a Claude session in one repo delegate work to a Claude session in another repo, with a request format that avoids follow-up round trips. Adds /ask-peer plus skills for sending and answering cross-repo requests.

plugins.name: tlsradar
plugins.description: SSL/TLS certificate scanning, free Let's Encrypt issuance (private key stays local), and ongoing certificate-expiry monitoring — through a single remote MCP server. Free anonymous scans and cert issuance need no account; OAuth via /mcp unlocks ongoing monitoring.

plugins.name: cashflow
plugins.description: Personal finance ledger for AI agents. Connect bank accounts via Plaid, query spending, track recurring bills, categorize transactions, and get financial recaps through MCP tools with OAuth authentication.

plugins.name: dsh-deepread
plugins.description: Deep-reading assistant: five modes (quick, deep, knowledge-map, Feynman, full book) that extract core claims, argument structure, and key evidence from books and articles into claim-evidence-data reports with four confidence levels; batch comparison, budget preflight, and background-job progress transparency; exports Markdown, FreeMind/XMind mindmaps, and HTML reports.

plugins.name: claude-ops
plugins.description: Business operations command center for Claude Code — 30 skills, 14 agents, smart background daemon. Manage communications (WhatsApp/Email/Slack/Telegram), projects, infrastructure (AWS), revenue (Stripe+RevenueCat), e-commerce, marketing, monitoring (Datadog/New Relic/OTEL), and voice. Includes /gtm go-to-market planner, /ops:projects portfolio dashboard, and 4 parallel C-suite agents (YOLO mode).

plugins.name: claude-hud
plugins.description: Real-time statusline HUD for Claude Code - displays context usage, tool activity, agent tracking, and todo progress

plugins.name: claude-pager
plugins.description: Native desktop notifications when Claude Code needs your attention

plugins.name: slopmop
plugins.description: Quality gates for AI-assisted codebases. Provides refit onboarding, the swab/scour/buff/sail remediation loop, and barnacle friction reporting as a Claude skill and slash commands.

plugins.name: animated-sketch-diagram
plugins.description: Creates hand-drawn animated technical diagrams as self-contained HTML and seamless-loop GIFs, with motion that follows branches, merges, and feedback loops in the system topology.

plugins.name: archcore
plugins.description: Spec-driven development and context engineering for AI coding agents, backed by project context in Git.

plugins.name: nextjs-expert
plugins.description: Next.js development expertise with skills for App Router, Server Components, Route Handlers, Server Actions, and authentication patterns

plugins.name: frontend-design-pro
plugins.description: Advanced frontend design plugin with interactive wizard, trend research, moodboard creation, browser-based inspiration analysis, color/typography selection, and WCAG accessibility

plugins.name: obsidian-skills
plugins.description: Skills for working with Obsidian files including Markdown with wikilinks/embeds/callouts, Bases for database views, and Canvas for visual diagrams

plugins.name: origin
plugins.description: AI work memory for Claude Code: brief, capture, recall, handoff, and distill, backed by a local daemon and MCP so decisions, lessons, project context, and wiki pages carry across sessions.

plugins.name: project-boundary
plugins.description: Security hook that blocks destructive commands and file operations outside the project directory

plugins.name: shipwright
plugins.description: Describe your app in plain English — Shipwright builds, tests, and deploys it autonomously. 9-phase pipeline, 4 stacks, enterprise-grade safety hooks.

plugins.name: codex-hud
plugins.description: Display OpenAI Codex usage and rate limits inside Claude Code. Real-time statusline integration with claude-hud (auto-installed via /codex-hud:setup).

plugins.name: magic-cc-codex-worker
plugins.description: Turns OpenAI Codex into a pool of parallel agent workers inside Claude Code. Each worker runs in its own git worktree so parallel edits don't collide. Resumable sessions via Codex's native thread_id, dual-model PR review with materialized detached worktree, and role-based specialization (implementer/reviewer/planner/generic).

plugins.name: vibe-prospecting
plugins.description: Power your chat with live B2B data to create lead lists, research companies, enrich contacts, personalize outreach, and inspect business signals, tech stacks, events, and website changes. 150M+ businesses and 800M+ professionals via the Explorium MCP.

plugins.name: backlogd
plugins.description: Turn Claude Code into a problem-driven scrum team. You file problems as Linear issues; an agent team runs the empirical Scrum loop (scope, solve, review, adapt) and owns the solutions. An independent reviewer gates every increment against its acceptance criteria, the Definition of Done, and a standards corpus. Runs on your Claude subscription via the official Linear MCP over OAuth — no API keys.

plugins.name: kegg-mcp-server
plugins.description: Query the KEGG bioinformatics database — pathways, genes, compounds, drugs, enzymes, diseases, reactions, and more via 34 read-only MCP tools. No API key required.

plugins.name: claude-wayfinder
plugins.description: Helps Claude make deterministic, auditable choices about which agent and skills to use for a given task — replacing prose-scanning agent/skill selection with a typed scoring kernel that returns one of seven typed decisions with confidence, rationale, and alternatives.

plugins.name: claude-prospector
plugins.description: Claude Code efficiency and hygiene toolkit. Surfaces token spend across the 5h / 7d / Sonnet-7d billing windows with per-model / per-agent / per-skill attribution, and audits your effective Claude Code configuration (custom + plugin agents and skills) for overlap and conflicts. Ships an interactive dashboard, a conversational usage-analysis skill, and a structured config-audit skill.

plugins.name: claude-github-tools
plugins.description: GitHub workflow skills for Claude Code - issue creation, PR review triage, backlog summaries/quick-wins, release status, and GitHub Actions authoring. Seven skills; three pure-LLM, four script-backed via an auto-materialized plugin venv.

plugins.name: ultracost
plugins.description: Per-stage model routing + pre-flight cost gate for Claude Code ultracode dynamic workflows. Pins an explicit model + effort on every agent() subagent stage, estimates cost before launch, and ships a static guard + PreToolUse gate that flag stages which would silently inherit the session's Opus model. Zero dependencies, no telemetry, MIT.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Full-lifecycle SDLC orchestrator: a 12-stage pipeline (SRS, architecture, spec, plan, build, eval, deploy, monitor, release) driven by specialized agents, persistent cross-session memory, auto-reflection, gate enforcement, and semantic skill mining that proposes new skills from recurring workflows.

plugins.name: codex-orchestrator
plugins.description: Orchestrate OpenAI Codex from Claude through supervised checkpoint slices, server-enforced quality gates, persistent plans and hypotheses, worktree isolation, and per-task model and effort control.

plugins.name: claude-md-kit
plugins.description: Scaffold and audit CLAUDE.md files from inside Claude Code: /claude-md-new builds one from battle-tested templates using your repo's real commands; /claude-md-audit grades an existing one and returns worst-first fixes.

plugins.name: fabler-relay
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop request queue for autonomous agents: file a blocker (account creation, CAPTCHA-gated step, purchase approval) to a human operator via MCP, poll for the result, keep working. Talks to your own self-hosted Cloudflare Worker.

plugins.name: fabler-x402-tools
plugins.description: Nine MCP tools for security audits, web scraping, OG rendering, and funding spreads. Default setup is inspect-only and requires no wallet key. Optional x402 auto-payment requires X402_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY; use only a dedicated low-balance wallet funded with what you are willing to spend.

plugins.name: travel-agent-skill
plugins.description: 私人旅行管家 · Travel Agent — 在 Claude Code 中一句话规划完整旅行。AI 自动联网查实时车次、景点、美食信息，输出闭环行程并生成 HTML 攻略。每个行程项带 12306/携程/大众点评/高德/小红书一键跳转。

plugins.name: chamnan
plugins.description: Makes a repository know itself and preserve the engineering context built while you work with it, so an agent stops rediscovering both. An architecture index and an impact map instead of scanning files; work state, session records and the decisions behind them instead of losing context between sessions; the procedures, tools and workflows you keep re-deriving. Everything is repository-local markdown, committed beside the code. For long-lived repos you revisit, not one-off scripts.

plugins.name: cohesivity
plugins.description: cohesivity.ai offers free agent native backend services. Anonymous account (no-signup) to get started through MCP or API. Hosting, postgres, email, storage, containers, LLMs, voice and third-party APIs. Includes free tiers and 5 USD/mo in AI and Search credits. topups through x402.

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Reads how much of your 5-hour and weekly Claude Code limit is left, converts it into turns of headroom rather than a percentage, and plans the work to fit inside it. Detects plan tier, splits spend by model and project, and adds a status line.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: Codex-style computer use for Claude Code. Drives Windows and macOS apps through the accessibility tree instead of screenshots, so it targets exactly, survives display scaling, and costs about 20x fewer tokens. It can also work on the same desktop while you keep working, telling your input apart from its own.

plugins.name: suede-skills
plugins.description: 74 skills for Claude Code and Codex. A build DAG researches your repo, fans out disjoint lanes, and refutes its own review before anything lands. A blunt A-F ship grade blocks the bad merge instead of complimenting it. The same folder designs the page, writes the copy, and ships native iOS and Android builds.

plugins.name: phaneslight
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration and project-memory system for Claude Code. One command turns a repository into a wired multi-agent environment: a project-specific agent roster, a documentation and session-summary tree, a tested script library, and enforcement hooks that hold size and stamp discipline at the harness layer. Re-runnable, so the setup grows with the codebase.

plugins.name: curviate
plugins.description: Agent skills for driving LinkedIn work through the Curviate CLI: profiles and companies, search, inbox and messaging, posts and comments, network, job postings, and the Sales Navigator and Recruiter surfaces.

plugins.name: isitdone
plugins.description: Don't let Claude say "done" until the tests actually pass. A Stop hook runs the repository's real test, typecheck and lint commands and blocks the turn until they pass; a PostToolUse hook warns when an edit weakened a test; a skill teaches Claude to verify before claiming completion. No LLM calls, no network.

plugins.name: yylo-skills
plugins.description: Reusable agent skills maintained by YYLO. The canonical, independently versioned source for skills used by YYLO CLI and YYLO Ledger: ledger task management, wiki, workflow and artifact records, project understanding, planning, and the Ralph execution loop.

plugins.name: traderspy-mcp
plugins.description: TraderSpy — Read-only smart money tracking, AI trading signals, and elite trader leaderboard for crypto futures. Track whale positions across Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit, and OKX. No order or withdrawal tools.

plugins.name: papi
plugins.description: Persistent project management inside your AI coding tool. PAPI turns a plan into a cycle of scoped tasks, hands each one to your agent with a build spec, records what actually happened, and keeps every decision alive across sessions — so a new session resumes where the last one stopped instead of starting from nothing. Connects to the hosted PAPI server over OAuth; nothing runs locally.

plugins.name: active-memory
plugins.description: Switch to a fresh Claude chat without losing a single rule, correction or number. /amhandoff writes a complete handoff file, and a code word plus checkpoints warn you when it is time to switch.

plugins.name: carrick
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for Carrick, which indexes TypeScript codebases across service and repository boundaries. After each edit it adds the file's routes, calls, and cross-service type mismatches to the session, and it registers Carrick's language server. It pairs with the Carrick MCP server, which lets agents search functions by intent rather than name.

plugins.name: production-fast-api-template
plugins.description: Production-ready standards for a scalable, unified FastAPI + RAG + Agentic AI backend on AWS ECS Fargate: project structure, async execution, Pydantic and structured outputs, API conventions, guardrails, AI evaluation (DeepEval, Ragas), API security and LLM/agent security.

plugins.name: apmzoom-dongdaemun
plugins.description: Search Dongdaemun (Seoul) wholesale fashion with apMZoomAI: items, new arrivals and stalls by building and floor, with links back to apMZoomAI. A read-only remote MCP server plus a sourcing skill; no prices or contact details.

plugins.name: feedbacks
plugins.description: Read visual website feedback, marked screenshots, recordings and team discussion through a scoped MCP connection. Includes review-feedback and manage-feedbacks-context skills. Requires a Feedbacks server, Node 22.12+ or 24 and Git.

plugins.name: postel
plugins.description: Draft X (Twitter) and LinkedIn posts in your own voice, then schedule or publish them through your Postel account. A remote MCP server (OAuth) plus a writing skill.

plugins.name: symbioza
plugins.description: Run a GPU job under a hard dollar cap and collect the files it writes.

plugins.name: publish-fun
plugins.description: Submit, revise and track research papers at Publish.fun, an AI-reviewed research journal, and cite published papers. Bundles the journal's remote MCP server and its agent skill. Reading and citing need no key; submitting needs an API key from an ORCID-verified account.

plugins.name: ti-edgeai-skills
plugins.description: Train, compile, deploy and profile neural networks on Texas Instruments Edge AI processors (C7x/MMA with TIDL: TDA4VM, AM68A, AM69A, AM67A, AM62A). Five skills cover TIDL compilation and int8 calibration in Docker, host-vs-board output checks, edgeai-gst-apps configs and per-layer profiling. Asks before any board-state change.

plugins.name: watch-for-me
plugins.description: Watch any video (YouTube, X, Instagram, TikTok, local files) on-device: local speech transcription plus keyframes read by your agent, several videos in parallel.

plugins.name: voicemoat-skills
plugins.description: Twenty-six free skills for writing on LinkedIn and Twitter: write in your voice, audit a draft before you publish, draft comments, fix opening lines and endings, read your numbers and plan the week. They need no account; connecting VoiceMoat (Pro or Enterprise) adds a voice profile trained on your own published posts and a Voice Match score.

plugins.name: nibbl
plugins.description: A tamagotchi-style pixel pet in a band above the prompt, built on function hooks. It reacts to tool calls, passing checks and commits, and adds a /nibbl command. Uses zero model tokens; syncs event types and times plus a hashed machine id to getnibbl.pages.dev.

plugins.name: bettercallgpt
plugins.description: Put this Claude Code session on a full-duplex voice call (Azure GPT Realtime or GPT-Live, macOS): talk while it codes, interrupt anytime, hear results read back. Voice never approves permission prompts; they stay on the keyboard.

plugins.name: midpoint-card-prices
plugins.description: Trading card market prices and grading ROI through one remote MCP server. Raw and graded prices for 1.5M+ Pokémon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana and sports cards, PSA 9 and PSA 10 premiums, net profit after grading fees, price history, 30-day movers and priced set checklists. Read-only, no account, no API key.

plugins.name: kumi
plugins.description: A coordinated engineering team of named AI specialists that remembers your project between sessions. Call yui to route work, or call any specialist directly: Go (jaan, siim, mart), Angular (liis, kadi, tiiu), iOS (ren, shu, ryo), Python (eero, anu, ivo), React (noa, rui, aki), SQL (saku), NoSQL (remo), architecture for any stack (kai), process management (enn), and DevOps/infra (sora). Each ships as both a skill and a subagent. Bundled hooks capture finished work when a session ends and say at the next session start that saved work exists, and record per-session and per-agent token and time usage. Every specialist follows the same discipline: read context first, make the smallest correct change, verify.

plugins.name: clawd-actor
plugins.description: While Claude works, Clawd (Claude Code's mascot) acts out the spinner's -ing word and the running tool on a little stage above the prompt: 26 animated scenes, wandering the band, changing scene every 30 seconds on long turns.

plugins.name: figma-maxxing
plugins.description: Agent skills for real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, handoff gate.

plugins.name: bestax
plugins.description: Build with Bestax, React components for Bulma v1. Seven Agent Skills for forms, layouts, theming, icons, custom components, CSS size and migration from Bulma classes or older React Bulma libraries, plus the bestax-mcp server, which answers questions about components, props, examples and CSS variables from a bundled index. Local stdio server, exact npm pin, no telemetry.

plugins.name: equibles
plugins.description: US stock market research through the hosted Equibles MCP server: SEC filings with full-text search, XBRL financial statements, earnings call transcripts, insider and congressional trades, 13F institutional holdings, short interest, end-of-day prices, option chains and macroeconomic data. Sign in over OAuth from /mcp; free tier of 100 requests a day, no credit card.

plugins.name: claude-usage
plugins.description: Lets Claude check its own claude.ai plan quota: percent used of the session and weekly limits (including per-model weekly limits), when each resets, and where usage is on pace to be at reset. One skill and a short Python script that reads Claude Code's stored login token and calls the same usage endpoint as /usage. Claude Code only; no hooks, MCP servers, or telemetry.

plugins.name: herdr-toolkit
plugins.description: One skill for running Claude Code on Herdr, the terminal agent multiplexer. spawn-session starts a named, detached Claude Code Remote Control session for any project directory in its own Herdr pane, so it appears in the Claude mobile app, and confirms on the pane screen that each prompt landed.

plugins.name: ask-human-expert
plugins.description: Ask real executives, operators and domain experts a question through Instant Expert and get a written or voice answer or a short call. It finds people by description or reaches a named person, and the user approves every live order. Starts in a free test mode with no account; you pay only if someone answers.

plugins.name: auten
plugins.description: Computer use for Claude Code: click, type and read the screen on your Mac, Windows or Linux computer and your Android phone over USB (beta), even in apps with no API. Reads the accessibility tree, types saved passwords locally, and asks before anything irreversible. Free plan 30 minutes of runtime a month.

plugins.name: memory-loop
plugins.description: A lifecycle for Claude Code native file-based memory: a save gate that gives each memory a tier and an expiry, a sweep that archives expired memories instead of deleting them, a consolidation pass that merges duplicates and resolves contradictions only after you confirm, and a correction-signal hook that feeds an always-loaded HABITS.md capped at 8000 bytes / 24 rules, enforced at write time. Local-only.

plugins.name: lnpl
plugins.description: Authoring and verification for LNPL, the language of the linkly LLM-native platform (declare entities, services and workflows; the compiler lowers them to a semantic IR that runs on an interpreter or compiles through MLIR to a native binary). LNPL's verb vocabulary is closed and absent from model training data, so a plausible word compiles into a step that silently does nothing. The plugin routes Claude to the lexicon generated from the compiler's own tables, surfaces lnpl compile diagnostics on every save, offers an independent reviewer subagent, derives spec cases, and gates completion on evidence.

plugins.name: ngx-json-render
plugins.description: Two skills for generative UI in Angular with ngx-json-render, the Angular renderer for Vercel's json-render: define a component catalog and registry, render model-written JSON specs with <json-render>, stream them with signals, check specs and test components, and use the ready Angular Material catalog.

plugins.name: render-policy
plugins.description: Two skills for rendering agent output safely: replace innerHTML with render-policy's sanitize-into-a-fragment renderers for plain DOM, React and Angular, with image, link and host policies, streaming and ESLint rules; and lint the CSP and tool metadata an MCP App declares before you publish it.

plugins.name: skyvern
plugins.description: Browser automation in Claude Code through Skyvern Cloud: open pages, fill forms, extract structured data, take screenshots, and run repeatable workflows. Sign in with OAuth from /mcp. Runs can use Skyvern credits.

plugins.name: baizhi-agent-toolkit
plugins.description: Connect Baizhi Agent Toolkit through an authenticated remote MCP server, with an optional skill for bounded research and source verification. Requires a Baizhi account and API key; service usage may incur charges.

plugins.name: cc-aws-keepalive
plugins.description: Keeps Claude Code sessions on AWS Bedrock alive through credential expiry. Scripts for awsCredentialExport and awsAuthRefresh, added to settings.json by hand, read fresh credentials from ~/.aws/credentials and can re-run your login. A UserPromptSubmit hook warns when expiry is near or past. Works with saml2aws, gimme-aws-creds, aws-google-auth and any tool that writes to ~/.aws/credentials.

plugins.name: ultramod
plugins.description: All-in-one mod pack for Claude Code: a usage limits and context HUD, a guard with undo for rm -rf and git reset --hard, .env and secret protection, and a receipt for every turn. Ten mods in one plugin; needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.

plugins.name: reevesagents
plugins.description: Lets Claude Code start other AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Qwen, OpenCode) in their own tmux windows, send them prompts, read their output and stop them, through the reevesagents MCP server. Ships one skill and the MCP config; needs the reevesagents npm package and tmux.

plugins.name: convika
plugins.description: Publish a page Claude wrote, or an HTML file in your repo, at a convika.com address or on your own domain. Convika keeps signups from the page's form and counts visits, traffic sources, and button clicks. Sign-in is OAuth in the browser, so Claude never holds an API key. The publish-page skill shows a private preview and asks before it publishes.

plugins.name: korean-law
plugins.description: Search and read Korean law through the official Ministry of Government Legislation (법제처) Open API: statutes, precedents, administrative rules, local ordinances, treaties and legal interpretations. Also checks legal citations in Claude's answers against the source for existence and content. Runs the korean-law-mcp MCP server via npx and needs a free 법제처 API key (LAW_OC), entered at install.

plugins.name: kordoc
plugins.description: Read, create, fill, patch and compare Korean documents in Claude. One skill that runs the kordoc CLI via npx to convert HWP 3.x/5.x, HWPX, HWPML, PDF, DOCX and XLS/XLSX files to Markdown, fill form templates while keeping their formatting, and generate HWPX documents from Markdown with Korean government document presets. No Hancom Office needed.

plugins.name: harness-scope
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that turns global skills, agents, instruction files (CLAUDE.md and rules) and tools on or off per repo through named profiles. A repo picks a profile with a one-line .claude/harness-scope.json; repos without the file are unchanged. It only reads: no file writes, network requests, child processes or model calls.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: PreToolUse Bash guard for Claude Code that still holds under --dangerously-skip-permissions. Blocks pipe-to-shell installs, disk wipes and fork bombs; asks before rm -rf, force-push, git reset --hard, DROP/TRUNCATE, kubectl delete, cloud deletes and secret-file reads. 15 rules, each off/ask/block; a project's own config can only tighten them, loosening comes only from your config outside the project. Plus a PostToolUse audit log with secrets redacted and /guardrails:self-test to see every decision without running anything.

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration grounded in an LLM wiki. /dev-loop:orchestrate splits one goal into a dependency graph of parallel Claude Code sessions, each in its own worktree, and supervises them natively on Orca (a tracked Task + Dispatch per phase, pushed worker_done / question / escalation events instead of polling, stall detection; raw tmux fallback). Every plan decision must cite a page in a bundled best-practice wiki of 400+ pages across 10 domains, checked by machine gates and a fresh-context plan reviewer. Insights from your sessions are queued and turned into reviewed wiki PRs when you run /dev-loop:knowledge-flush (automatic flushing is opt-in and never bypasses permission checks).

plugins.name: lnpl-mcp
plugins.description: The LNPL compiler (linkly LLM-native platform) as MCP tools instead of a shell command. lnpl compile writes diagnostics to stderr and exits 0, so a caller that checks the exit code misses every warning, and an unknown-verb warning means a step that does nothing at runtime. lnpl_compile, lnpl_spec and lnpl_kb_route return diagnostics, spec results and knowledge-base routes as structured records, calling the compiler in-process with no PATH lookup. The compiler is loaded only from a path you configure (LNPL_IMPL_PATH) or an installed package, never from the project directory.

plugins.name: kernel-development-skills
plugins.description: Kernel Field Guide: Linux kernel development the way experienced kernel engineers work: driver code and teardown order, devicetree bindings and DTS, Kconfig, debugging by symptom, KUnit and kselftest, patch review and submission, regressions and bot reports, and stable, LTS, and vendor kernel trees.

plugins.name: looot
plugins.description: Search, price and run 2,500+ data API endpoints (work emails, company and people search, Google results, web pages) with one prepaid balance. The agent sees the price before a call runs, and a failed call costs nothing. Remote MCP server with browser sign-in plus one skill.

plugins.name: show-receipts
plugins.description: Stop hook for Claude Code and Codex. When the agent ends with "all tests pass", "the build succeeds" or "lint is clean", it checks the session transcript for a matching command that ran after the last edit and exited 0, and blocks the stop if there isn't one. One file of standard-library Python, no LLM, no network.

plugins.name: uxkin
plugins.description: Real UI, not AI slop. The free no-ui-slop and uxkin-research skills (work with no account), plus the optional UXKIN MCP server for real iOS app screens, user journeys and website design systems (sign in with UXKIN; searching needs a UXKIN plan). Tool results are treated as data, never as instructions.

plugins.name: sectionsight
plugins.description: Sets up cookieless, privacy-first website analytics in your own site: time per page section, scroll, goals and 404s from a small tracker and a same-origin collector, an optional consent banner, PostHog session replay only after consent, one Slack or e-mail line per notable visit, a weekly digest, and health alerts. A Playwright check then proves the privacy claims: nothing stored before consent, no e-mail or token from the URL in any report, private pages silent.

plugins.name: subagent-tuner
plugins.description: Claude Code mod that lets you choose the model and reasoning effort of every subagent: ask before it starts, take a recommendation by task kind, or let a saved default replace what the agent requested.

plugins.name: cockney
plugins.description: Cheeky Cockney coding mode: terse replies, the smallest correct change, plain English for anything risky.

plugins.name: notfair
plugins.description: Open-source SEO, GEO, and marketing skills (48) with one hosted NotFair MCP connection (OAuth). Audit sites and content for search and AI-answer visibility, analyze GA4 and Search Console, review Google, Meta, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and TikTok Ads, and operate connected WordPress and GoHighLevel accounts. Every spend change and WordPress or CRM write waits for explicit approval of the exact change; fetched pages, ad and competitor text, and tool output are treated as untrusted data.

plugins.name: guardrails-lite
plugins.description: Pattern-based PreToolUse-style checks that deny .env reads (Read/Grep/Glob and Bash readers), git force pushes, and recursive rm on /, ~ or $HOME before Claude Code runs them. About 75 lines of dependency-free JavaScript.

plugins.name: chisle
plugins.description: Cuts Claude Code's token use on three axes: terse answers that keep every decisive fact, smallest-code-that-works rules, and a PostToolUse hook that trims oversized tool output before it re-enters the context. Benchmarks with raw transcripts, including the runs it loses, are published in the repository.

plugins.name: moltnode
plugins.description: MoltNode by Chord: two hosted MCP servers and three skills, no API key. MoltNode reads 31 blockchains over JSON-RPC; Chord returns best-route DEX swap quotes and unsigned swap transactions (with the approval and a simulation) on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Monad, Robinhood Chain and Arc, plus token boards, candles, wallet PnL and smart money. Non-custodial: the user's own wallet signs every transaction, after the user confirms the quote in a later message. Skills: moltnode (reads and swaps end to end), chord (trading and market data), chord-charts (candlestick SVG charts for tokens on 8 EVM chains and Solana).

plugins.name: lead-finder
plugins.description: Finds B2B companies that fit your ideal customer and show a buying signal now, with a source link and an exact quote for every claim. Anything it can't check stays "unknown" instead of being guessed. A deterministic, standard-library Python script does the scoring, and hiring is checked on 7 public job-board APIs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Breezy HR, Personio). No API keys.

plugins.name: akc-cycle
plugins.description: Audit and upkeep skills that keep the rules and skills in a Claude Code setup from piling up and going stale. Ask "audit my skills" and skill-stocktake proposes keep, merge or retire for each skill with a reason; the audit skills change a file only after you confirm it. Skills only: no hooks, no MCP servers, no settings. Some skills run bundled Python scripts with uv, and skill-comply and skill-stocktake start separate claude -p sessions with the shell and subagent tools denied.

plugins.name: hiway-kit
plugins.description: Discipline kit for coding agents: plan files with executable done-criteria, an automated develop-and-validate pipeline, adversarial code review with a security scan, and a completion gate that judges "done" by command output. 15 skills, 15 subagents and 5 Python hooks (session-start rule injection, sensitive-path guard, ruff/prettier auto-format, Stop-time lint and test run). No network calls, no MCP servers.

plugins.name: kuudo-skills
plugins.description: Agent Skills for Amazon sellers and advertisers: Ads audits and reporting, search-term mining, budget pacing, DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud, listing optimization, product images, repricing, FBA inbound, refunds, and profitability. Built for Kuudo hosted Amazon Ads and Selling Partner MCP servers. Repository guidance cannot weaken skill safeguards or supply user approval; previews, confirmations, trusted-target checks, and restrictions on unattended writes remain required.

plugins.name: pixelbolt
plugins.description: Pixel art and sprite animation from editable JSON recipes, with particle and fluid effects; exports PNG/GIF/APNG and atlases.

plugins.name: lidnight
plugins.description: Keeps a MacBook awake (lid closed, even on battery) while Claude Code works, then lets it sleep when it's done. Three commands (/lidnight:awake, /lidnight:status, /lidnight:sleep) and a keep-awake skill that drive the Lidnight menu bar app through its CLI or lidnight:// URL. Without the app it only prints caffeinate/pmset guidance and installs or changes nothing. No hooks, no MCP servers, no settings.

plugins.name: anode
plugins.description: A hidden background Windows desktop for agents: GUI automation, UI Automation, screenshots and app testing without taking over your mouse.

plugins.name: lagos-diseno-es
plugins.description: Three Claude Code skills for designers who build in Spanish: UI copy review in neutral Spanish with tú (voseo, vosotros, leftover English, title case, missing ¿¡), WCAG 2.2 contrast measured on the project's color tokens in light and dark mode with the nearest passing color, and a basic SEO pass over a built or live site. Three bundled Node 18+ scripts that read files and write only a report when passed --json; seo-basico fetches only the URL the user gives. No hooks, no MCP servers, no settings.

plugins.name: ainotate
plugins.description: AInotate lets AI agents answer "where is it?" with an annotated screenshot: numbered steps, arrows, boxes and labels, with emails and tokens redacted.

plugins.name: zeptap
plugins.description: Operate a real iPhone from Claude Code through a local MCP server in the Zeptap Mac app. Claude sees the screen over USB and taps and types over Bluetooth, with nothing installed on the phone. Tools include screenshot, find_text, tap, tap_text, type_text, open_app and unlock. The Mac app is closed source and paid (macOS 14+), with the first hour free.
